project_name: Système de Gestion de Maintenance Technique (K-Technology)
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO

headings.rules: tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), never use Inter, never center-align by default.

body.rules: left-aligned, highly legible, clean for dense technical data.

technical_data.rules: used for KPIs, IDs, and stats for precision and tabular alignment.

colors.strategy: Brutalist Monochrome with high-contrast functional accents.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (MODE B) with 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look).
layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing for outer containers (p-8 to p-12), dense padding for table cells (p-3).
layouts.borders: Visible skeleton. Use border-collapse styles. 1px borders for structure.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content. Top-left for primary KPIs. Avoid center alignment.

components.strategy: Shadcn/UI, modified for a 'Cardless / Sharp Edge' look.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form. DO NOT use native HTML <input> or <select>.
components.tables: Compact, dense data display. Clear alignment, row density control. Use master-detail views.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts). Line charts for trends, bar charts for comparisons.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 0px (sharp) or max 4px radius. 1px border. No soft drop-shadows.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' to expose the skeleton. Avoid Glassmorphism in main dashboard areas to prevent data refraction. Use Solid Backgrounds with hard borders.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brightens. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
visual_enhancers.focus_states: High contrast ring. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback. Avoid universal 'transition: all'. Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards against backgrounds. Never use pure transparent backgrounds under text.
accessibility.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

logo.description: Minimalist 3D letter K on a box, to be used as branding/logo.

login_background.description: Abstract black and blue industrial geometry for login/auth screen background.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Create the app using .js extensions for React components, NOT .tsx (since the project uses JS). Adjust Shadcn component generation commands accordingly.
Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' and default centered layouts. Implement the Brutalist Monochrome color strategy.
Never apply a global 'transition: all'. Use targeted transitions.
Implement real-time styled status indicators for active tasks, incidents (e.g. Signal Orange for Urgent).
Make charts task-driven (Line for trends, Bar for comparisons). Limit the use of pie/donut charts.
Implement persistent filters and master-detail view patterns for FDI, RDD, and RDI sheets to avoid excessive navigation.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for technical/dense dashboard iconography.
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn components for everything (dropdowns, calendar, dialogs).
For the dashboard grid, use a hierarchical F-pattern layout with the primary KPI on top-left.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key UI elements.
Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Build the dashboard side navigation strictly differentiating between User and Admin roles.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭). Provide custom scrollbar CSS (no gutter). NEVER use placeholder URLs for images. Emphasize functional clarity over decorative elements for this technical app.
